metadata.name: Retention Policy Schema
metadata.description: Ensures assets have proper lifecycle and retention metadata. Use this to enforce data governance policies around asset expiry, archival, and disposal.

description: Enforces lifecycle and retention metadata for data governance compliance.

retention_days.description: Minimum retention period in days before asset can be disposed

disposal_method.description: How the asset should be handled after retention period expires

data_owner.description: Email of the person or team accountable for retention compliance

legal_hold.description: Whether the asset is under legal hold (prevents disposal regardless of retention)

regulation.description: Applicable regulation or policy (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, FedRAMP, NARA)

last_access_review.description: Date of the last access review (ISO 8601)

next_review_date.description: Date of the next scheduled retention review (ISO 8601)
